# Women's Meetups in Amsterdam

> Small coffee meetups for women in Amsterdam, called Table of Six. Six women per table, matched on personality type, work or study field, age and language, in cosy cafés and hidden spots across Amsterdam. €8 per meetup including the first coffee, no subscription or membership. For Dutch and English-speaking women. Founded and hosted by Boanna Pieterse.

## Key facts
- What: Table of Six, a coffee meetup for six women at one table, with conversation cards and an icebreaker from the host.
- Where: cafés and hidden spots in Amsterdam (De Pijp, Jordaan, Oost, West, Noord, Centrum). Exact location is shared two days before.
- Who: women who live in, study in, work in or visit Amsterdam. Many are in their twenties; women in their thirties and beyond, newcomers and travellers are welcome too.
- Language: Dutch tables, English tables and mixed tables. Visitors choose when signing up.
- Price: €8 per meetup, first coffee included. No subscription, no yearly fee.
- How often: once a month, moving to every two weeks. Several tables run at the same time when more women sign up.
- Not a dating service: friendship only.
- Founder and host: Boanna Pieterse, former musical theatre actress, content creator and presenter. Instagram @boannap, YouTube @boannathroughtwenties.
